name: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. II
summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. II functions as a special purpose acquisition company, established with the explicit aim of completing a business combination. This could encompass various strategic transactions, such as a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset or share purchase, or a reorganization, involving one or more target enterprises. The firm was founded on August 1, 2025, and its principal executive offices are located in New York, NY.
